# Discovering classes

Attach to the running app first:

```text
[0x00000000]> Froj frida://attach/usb//FridaMin
{"ok":true,"result":{"action":"attach","pid":2812,"resumed":false,"state":"attached"}}
```

## Classloaders

```text
[0x00000000]> FrLj
{"ok":true,"result":{"loaders":[{"id":1,"type":"dalvik.system.PathClassLoader","toString":"dalvik.system.PathClassLoader[DexPathList[[directory \".\"],...]]"},{"id":2,"type":"java.lang.BootClassLoader","toString":"java.lang.BootClassLoader@1984a97"},{"id":3,"type":"dalvik.system.PathClassLoader","toString":"dalvik.system.PathClassLoader[DexPathList[[zip file \"/data/app/.../base.apk\"],...]]"}]}}
```

Three loaders, each with an integer `id` for the session:

1. the system loader,
2. the boot classloader,
3. the app loader: its `toString` names the apk path.

![Classloaders](img/android_journey/loaders.png)

## Loaded classes

```text
[0x00000000]> FrCj re.frida
{"ok":true,"result":{"classes":[{"name":"re.frida.minapp.StringUtils"},{"name":"re.frida.minapp.NativeLib"},{"name":"re.frida.minapp.secret.SecretVault"},...,{"name":"re.frida.minapp.game.GameState"},{"name":"re.frida.minapp.MainActivity$6"}],"total":21,"truncated":false}}
```

`FrCj` lists loaded classes, optionally filtered by a prefix. The
filter matches a canonical name that starts with the prefix, or a simple
name after the last dot that equals it, so `FrCj SecretVault` and
`FrCj re.frida.minapp.secret.SecretVault` both hit. `total` is the
count, `truncated` reports whether `frida.java.max` cut the list
(default 512 classes per request, 0 means unlimited). Pressing Load Plugin
adds the two dynamic classes, raising the total to 23.

![Loaded classes](img/android_journey/classes.png)

The demo classes are all here: `secret.SecretVault`, `game.GameState`,
`license.LicenseChecker` and the `MainActivity$3..6` click listeners.

A miss shows how the filter behaves:

```text
[0x00000000]> FrCj kotlin.
{"ok":true,"result":{"classes":[],"total":0,"truncated":false}}
```

minapp is smali-built, so it carries no Kotlin metadata.

## Describe a class

```text
[0x00000000]> FrDj re.frida.minapp.secret.SecretVault
{"ok":true,"result":{"name":"re.frida.minapp.secret.SecretVault","modifiers":1,"flags":["public"],"super":"java.lang.Object","interfaces":[],"fields":[{"name":"SECRET_B64","type":"java.lang.String","modifiers":26,"flags":["private","static","final"]}],"methods":[{"name":"getSecret","returnType":"java.lang.String","parameterTypes":[],"modifiers":9,"flags":["public","static"],"isNative":false},{"name":"checkSecret","returnType":"boolean","parameterTypes":["java.lang.String"],"modifiers":9,"flags":["public","static"],"isNative":false},{"name":"nativeCheckSecret","returnType":"boolean","parameterTypes":["java.lang.String"],"modifiers":265,"flags":["public","static","native"],"isNative":true},{"name":"encode","returnType":"java.lang.String","parameterTypes":["java.lang.String"],"modifiers":9,"flags":["public","static"],"isNative":false}],"constructors":[{"parameterTypes":[],"modifiers":1,"flags":["public"]}],"loader":0}}
```

`FrDj` returns the superclass, interfaces, fields, methods with
`isNative`, constructors and the loader id. Note `nativeCheckSecret`:
`isNative:true`: a method implemented in C, not Java.

When a class was compiled with Kotlin, the reply also carries the
`@kotlin.Metadata` payload (`k`, `mv`, `xi`, `bv`, `data1Len`, `data2Len`).
Smali-built minapp has none of that.

![Class description](img/android_journey/describe.png)

## Autocomplete

`FrDj` and `FrImj` complete class names with Tab. Completion starts
after `frida.ac.min` characters (default 2) and suggests at most
`frida.ac.max` names (default 12):

```text
[0x00000000]> FrDj re.frida.minapp.s<TAB>
secret.SecretVault   StringUtils   ...
```

```text
[0x00000000]> e frida.ac.min
2
[0x00000000]> e frida.ac.max
12
```

::: {.callout-tip}
### Try

List the loaders, list every `re.frida` class, then describe
`re.frida.minapp.game.GameState`: note the public static `premium` and
`coins` fields you will change later.
:::
